caption: This drawing depicts an aerial or top-down view of a landscaped estate labeled as "The Joseph Fischer Estate – The Blackwell Survey 1860." The central object is a rectangular brown and gray-roofed building, surrounded by a light tan walking path and an oval of pink-bordered garden beds. Beyond this, there are concentric circles of green lawn and trees, with several smaller paths extending outward. In the upper right, a small square red-roofed structure sits at the end of a path. In the lower left, there is a rectangular grid area of tan and green lines, possibly representing a garden or field. A circular red-tan feature and a circular floral or patterned element with a red center and radiating designs are visible in the bottom half of the composition. Variously colored patches of green indicate different vegetation, with medium green tones dominating the open grassy areas and darker greens representing clusters of trees, particularly in the lower right and upper right corners. Tree shapes are individually painted, with both broadleaf and coniferous forms apparent. Paths are rendered in a light beige color, and border planting beds are depicted in circular and curved patterns around the central building. The estate’s boundaries and detailed landscape elements, such as trees and garden beds, are shown in a watercolor style, and the surveyed area is surrounded by a simple beige frame.
title: Joseph Fisher Estate
